evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'I wanted to touch base with you know, gather some more details' but never delivers the recognizable framing: 'takes about 10 to 15 minutes, you can walk away with a quote you can depend on, does that sound good?' — no time-boxed ask, no wait for yes.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Confirmed: move date (October 11th), origin (731 Bridgestone way in boda, one story, 1890 sq ft), destination (17301 visa samples drive in Fluger, 45 min to hour drive), and size gathered upfront.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked before probing: 'what are you most worried about for this upcoming move or is there any specific questions that you'd like me to address on this call?' — customer replied no concerns, prior move with Einstein.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (one story house), square footage (1890), number of rooms (implied single-family), walking distance/stories (one story to one story), additional rooms (customer stated 'basically one story to one story house, no additional stop'), special considerations (downsizing, leaving furniture behind, junk pickup), appliances (confirmed no washer/dryer/fridge). Inventory detailed: sectional, coffee tables, TV consoles, cabinet, dressers, nightstands, dining table, three safes, full-size mattress.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Asked: 'When it comes to boxes, do you need our help packing or would you have the boxes ready to go?' Customer declined.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked with anchor: 'we usually see 75 to 95 boxes coming out of it like a fully packed 1800 square foot home. But in your case since you're downsizing, what's a good ballpark number?' Customer estimated zero to ten boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Range given with personalization: 'budget for let's see maybe six to eight hours, just in case we're running into heavy traffic on that day... if it only takes us six hours... $1,335... while eight hours is $1,755... in case it takes six to eight hours to complete the move.' Personalized to customer's stated prep level (already started moving small items) and reduced mover count due to inventory.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Disclosed: '$210 per hour with two movers, all inclusive hourly rate, 26 foot box truck, moving blankets, shrink wrap, benches, dollies, tools, taxes, insurance and gas included. One time travel fee $75. Two and a half hour minimum, prorated in fifteen minute increments.' Also mentioned no credit card fees, no disassemble/reassembly fees.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: After estimate, rep asks 'Do you have any questions so far?' — customer replies 'No, not so far.' Rep then immediately re-pitches differentiators without ever asking 'Does that feel fair?' or holding silence for genuine reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered: 'if we are late for some reasons we do have the on time guarantee. We will give you a discount for, for the time that we are made.' Terms are clear (discount starts immediately if late).
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial: mentions '$2,000 per move to either repair, replace or reimburse any damages cost by our team. There's no additional fee for this insurance' but omits explicit 'no deductible/no fine print' framing and clarity that it's built into the rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False — rep asks 'What do you think? Would you like us to hop out with this move?' but never asks 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirms the Two Promises resolved customer concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked — call ends with customer needing to leave for a meeting. No genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or similar final check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked — no 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' before close.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Asked with built-in out: 'Would you like us to hop out with this move?' is plain, but immediately followed by 'I will email you the quote if you're not you're ready to book now. If you have any questions or whenever you're ready just give me a call back' — provides easy email/defer path without commitment.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned — rep never states rates are locked or guaranteed once quoted.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial — rep confirms: no date (customer deferred to decide with husband), no phone number confirmed (rep provides hers, not confirming customer's), no arrival window discussed, no crew size stated for final booking, addresses already known but not re-confirmed, no crew notes about customer's concerns left (customer mainly concerned about having enough movers for large furniture, never asked to be prioritized in notes).

top_strength: Amy gathered detailed inventory and logistics through careful probing and active reflection (echoing back 'three piece sectional, two coffee tables...' and correcting 'three safes'), giving her the exact information needed to quote accurately and confidently.
coaching_note: Always ask 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing and hold the silence for a real response before launching into differentiators — this call skipped that critical checkpoint and moved straight into re-pitching, losing the chance to address any price concern before it became an objection.
